body_markdown:
**September 11, 2026 9:00 AM**
Newmark announces the Company has arranged a $55 million loan on behalf of Mack Real Estate Group, Silverstein Properties and Cantor Fitzgerald to refinance Swell Apartments, a 200-unit Class A multifamily community in Seattle, Washington. Newmark Arranges Refinancing for Swell Apartments, Class A Multifamily Community in Seattle, Washington.


Co-Head of Global[Debt & Structured Finance](https://www.nmrk.com/services/investor-solutions/capital-markets/debt-and-structured-finance)[Jordan Roeschlaub](https://www.nmrk.com/people/jordan-roeschlaub) , Vice Chairman[Chris Kramer](https://www.nmrk.com/people/christopher-kramer) , Senior Associate[Sam Speciale](https://www.nmrk.com/people/samuel-speciale) and Analyst Lance Tillman arranged the financing with ORIX.


Completed in 2024, Swell Apartments is a newly constructed luxury apartment community located in Seattle’s Yesler Terrace neighborhood. The 200-unit property offers a mix of market-rate and affordable residences with contemporary finishes, including stainless steel appliances, floor-to-ceiling windows and in-unit laundry. Residents also benefit from a robust amenity package featuring a rooftop sky lounge, fitness center, coworking and lounge spaces, private dining areas, bike storage and controlled-access parking.


Positioned within one of Seattle’s most connected residential neighborhoods, the property offers immediate access to the Seattle Streetcar and Interstate 5, providing convenient connectivity to Downtown Seattle and the region’s leading employment centers. Swell Apartments is also located near major employers, including Amazon, Microsoft, Costco and Starbucks, as well as the city’s premier entertainment and cultural destinations.
